text.args.mjs: parses a command's positionals and options against its table and reads the comment or pull request text from an option or a file
text.args.mjs gotcha: A byte-identical copy lives in the other two integration skills, pinned by a test, so change all three.
text.args.mjs see-also: each integration skill keeps its own copy because a skill may import only from its own folder
text.bitbucket-api.mjs: Bitbucket Cloud requests with basic auth against the 2.0 API, as get, post and put, and the scopes the last answer granted
text.bitbucket-api.mjs = ext:bitbucket-api: pull request lookups, creation, comments and description updates
text.bitbucket.mjs: entry that runs the Bitbucket skill's command line
text.block.mjs: reads a marked block's name and text from options and puts it into a description, replacing an earlier block of that name
text.block.mjs gotcha: A begin marker counts only when its end marker follows, so an orphaned one swallows nothing.
text.block.mjs see-also: byte-identical copy in the GitHub skill, pinned by a test
text.cli.mjs: runs one command: checks usage, completes missing credentials from Lantern, calls Bitbucket and prints every line through the redactor with an exit code
text.cli.mjs = skills/lantern-bitbucket/scrip: asks Lantern for the account only when no credential is set
text.commands.mjs: the command table and the pull request actions behind it: list, show, comment, create from the current branch or a named one, check the account and keep a marked description block, plus the offline conventions and template commands
text.conventions.mjs: lists the pull request templates, the user's own skills about them and the saved templates by name and path only, and saves or prints a project template
text.conventions.mjs gotcha: Never reads a template or skill body beyond the description line, and refuses to replace a saved template without force.
text.conventions.mjs see-also: byte-identical copies in the other two integration skills, pinned by a test
text.commands.mjs gotcha: Create pushes the branch first and opens no second pull request for a branch that already has one.
text.credentials.mjs: names the two variables Lantern injects, lists the missing ones, derives the secrets to mask, declares what to ask Lantern for and says where the account came from
text.git.mjs: runs git with prompts off and checks a branch is ready to publish before a plain push of HEAD to it
text.git.mjs gotcha: Only tracked changes count as dirty, so a scratch pull request body in the tree does not block a push.
text.git.mjs see-also: identical copy in the GitHub skill, pinned by a test
text.http.mjs: sends JSON requests with a timeout and turns a refusal into an error that carries the redacted start of the body
text.http.mjs gotcha: The body is redacted before it is cut, so a token straddling the limit leaves no fragment.
text.http.mjs see-also: byte-identical copies in the other two integration skills, pinned by a test
text.lantern-socket.mjs: asks the running Lantern over its local socket for the project's account when the environment has none, keeping the answer in memory
text.lantern-socket.mjs gotcha: The environment always wins: a single required variable set means the socket is never contacted.
text.lantern-socket.mjs see-also: byte-identical copies in the other two integration skills, pinned by a test
text.lantern-socket.mjs = src/main/auth/crede: sends the working directory and provider, reads the variables or the refusal
text.messages.json: every sentence the Bitbucket skill prints
text.messages.mjs: looks up a message by dotted key and fills its placeholders, returning the key when missing
text.redact.mjs: masks known secrets in any form, Authorization header values and credentials inside URLs
text.remote.mjs: finds the remotes that point at bitbucket.org, reads workspace and repository from their URL and picks one by name or the only one
